- [ ] I have made sure my commit messages are changelog compatible  
    - Commit messages that should appear in a **user-facing** changelog contain a simplified [changelog trailer](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/changelogs/)  
       Simplified, as we only use `feat`, `fix` and `misc`  
        - The commit head and any additional body text or trailer are separated by a blank line
        - Examples:  

          ```text
          Fix DS4 Emulation, add metadata handling

              - Fix Gyro-Stutter
              - Fix Triggers

          Changelog(fix)
          ```

          ```text
          DS4 Emulation

          Changelog(feat)
          ```
